about_the_game:
Vending Machine Co., a cozy management game where you grow a vending machine business across a Japanese-inspired city full of life, charm, and opportunity.

Start small, with just a few machines and limited items. Choose your first neighborhood—will you begin in the quiet streets of Komorebi Homes or the bustling pop culture paradise of Otaku Alley?

Explore the city map and unlock new districts, each with unique residents and preferences. From tired salarymen in the business district to curious tourists near temple grounds, everyone needs a snack, drink, or quirky gadget—and you’re here to deliver!

Core Gameplay:

  • 🗾 Explore and unlock neighborhoods with different buyer types

  • 🛠️ Install and upgrade vending machines across pre-set city spots

  • 🛒 Buy wholesale items like ramen, gachapon toys, green tea, and gadgets

  • 💸 Set prices based on local demand and daily market trends

  • 📦 Add machine features like drink heaters, coolers, and QR payments

  • 🎮 Enjoy chill upgrades, cozy vibes, and satisfying sales flow

As your empire grows, so will your catalog. Stock seasonal goods, keep up with trends, and make each machine a perfect match for its area.

Whether you’re optimizing profits or just vibing with the ambient lo-fi and cicadas, Vending Machine Co. lets you build your business at your own pace with different game modes that fit your preference!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04, SteamOS (Proton-8 Recommended)
  • Processor: 1.7 GHz Processor
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8 or higher, ATI X1600 or higher, or Intel HD 3000 or higher
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: Proton-8 Recommended

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.6 or above
  • Processor: Apple Silicon M1 (M2 and M3) or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 1 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 1280x720 minimum resolution, OpenGL 2.0 Support, and recommended dedicated graphics card with 128 MB of RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: M1, M2, M3 Silicon Mac & ARM Supported

short_description: Run your kawaii vending machine company! A relaxing sim where you run your own vending machine company across a charming Japanese city. Pick neighborhoods, stock up on snacks, and set the perfect price. Upgrade your machines and keep them stocked, one soda at a time!
